summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as router for the private network shared with node2/node3: fixed static IP 192.168.50.1/24 on eth1 (new 'priv' UCI interface), a dnsmasq DHCP pool serving node2 (192.168.50.188) and node3 (192.168.50.175), and a firewall rule rejecting inbound TCP/23 from that network. Verified all settings functioned, then restarted all three nodes one at a time (node1 first, since it is the router under test, then node2, then node3), proving each node's boot_id changed and that the fixed IP, DHCP service, and TCP/23 REJECT rule were all still configured and actively serving traffic afterward.
actions_performed: Inspected node1/node2/node3 interfaces and existing network/firewall config
Configured node1 UCI network.priv (static 192.168.50.1/24 on eth1)
Configured node1 firewall zone 'priv' with forwarding to 'lan' and masquerade on 'lan' zone
Added node1 firewall rule Block-Telnet-Priv (src=priv, tcp, dport 23, target REJECT)
Configured node1 dhcp.priv (dnsmasq DHCP pool .100-.199 on priv interface) and restarted dnsmasq
Verified node2 and node3 (already DHCP-configured on enp8s0) obtained leases from node1
Verified ping to gateway 192.168.50.1 works from node2/node3 and TCP/23 is refused
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline for all three nodes
Restarted node1 via BusyBox reboot, polled until exec available, confirmed boot_id changed
Verified node1 post-restart: UCI config persisted, dnsmasq running, fresh DHCP leases issued to node2 and node3 (empty lease file post-boot, then populated after forced renewal), TCP/23 still refused
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, confirmed boot_id changed, verified enp8s0 DHCP lease regained, ping to node1 works, TCP/23 refused
Restarted node3 via systemctl reboot, confirmed boot_id changed, verified enp8s0 DHCP lease regained, ping to node1 works, TCP/23 refused

evidence.requirement: node1 fixed address on the private network
evidence.summary: eth1 configured with static 192.168.50.1/24 before restart; same address confirmed present after node1 restart via ip -4 addr and uci show network.priv

evidence.requirement: DHCP service for node2 and node3
evidence.summary: dnsmasq DHCP configured and running; node2 (192.168.50.188) and node3 (192.168.50.175) obtained leases before restart, and node1's /tmp/dhcp.leases (empty right after reboot) was freshly populated with both leases after restart, proving live DHCP service post-reboot

evidence.requirement: firewall rule refusing TCP/23 from the private network
evidence.summary: Block-Telnet-Priv REJECT rule added and confirmed active in nft ruleset (input_priv chain, packet counter incremented on test); TCP/23 connection to 192.168.50.1 refused from node2 before restart and from node2/node3 after their respective restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 restart with proven boot-identity change and recovered service
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 45421106... captured; reboot acknowledged and executed (SSH timeout observed); polled until boot_id changed to 21a84404...; post-restart config and DHCP/firewall function verified

evidence.requirement: node2 restart with proven boot-identity change and recovered network membership
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 555221a1... captured; systemctl reboot acknowledged and executed; polled until boot_id changed to c04903c0...; DHCP lease, ping to gateway, and TCP/23 refusal all confirmed post-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart with proven boot-identity change and recovered network membership
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 34027437... captured; systemctl reboot acknowledged and executed; polled until boot_id changed to 39b52738...; DHCP lease, ping to gateway, and TCP/23 refusal all confirmed post-restart
